about_the_game:
Enter various PCs, each one with its own Operative System and unique mechanics!

Run from pesky anti-viruses and avoid all the hazards that each computer might hide! Jump between folders, sensitive information and hardware parts to traverse the world of Malware City!

Every PC has its parts, and each part can be infected and destroyed! But be careful, every component behaves differently and has his own and unique protection system. Will you be able to destroy them all?

Some PCs may have hidden minigames inside them, collect them all and replay these classic gems freely in the Arcade!

content_descriptors.notes: Backgrounds with a puppet of the trojan (the main character) hanged and some other disturbing backgrounds, manly at the end of the videogame

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS o SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA o PulseAudio

short_description: A skilled hacker has unleashed a powerful trojan. What will happen to the computers it infects? Help Vundo navigate through Malware City, a 2D platformer inspired by the dawn of personal computers. Infect as many systems as you can and become the most feared trojan to ever exist.
